content:
Ratings reflect move-day reality

In Addis Ababa, reviews cluster around the same themes: Did the truck arrive when promised? Did the final bill match the quote? Did security accept the crew? Active Movers focuses on those operational basics—not marketing slogans—so residential and office moves feel controlled.

Written scope before deposit

Quotes reference inventory, truck class, crew size, and what happens if stairs or standby time appear. That discipline reduces curb disputes—see price creep prevention and contract red flags. Starting tiers are public on the 2026 cost guide and homepage pricing.

Condo and gate experience

Crews work with freight lift slots, security ID lists, and compound etiquette daily across Bole, CMC, Jemo, Ayat, and Kazanchis. We confirm truck plate before load—standard dispatch practice. Use our condo checklist alongside booking.

Protection on Addis streets

Blankets, stretch wrap, and careful load geometry matter on cobblestone and tight turns. Fragile items need labeled cartons—packing guide.

Communication you can reach

Supervisors answer scheduling and access questions before move day. Call +251982260000 or book online with origin, destination, and floor notes.

Organizations rebook when downtime is expensive—weekend Kazanchis phases, labeled workstations, and IT coordination. See Kazanchis office guide and office relocation from 45,000 ETB.
